statement: Whenever check_record(s) returns a result r, r = true if and only if both: (1) the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(s) and s[i] = 65 ('A') is strictly less than 2; and (2) there is no index i with 0 <= i, i + 2 < len(s), and s[i] = s[i+1] = s[i+2] = 76 ('L').
preconditions: len(s) >= 1 and len(s) <= 1000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] is one of 65 ('A'), 76 ('L'), 80 ('P').

statement: For every s satisfying the preconditions, check_record(s) returns a Bool result; it does not fail (no out-of-bounds access, arithmetic overflow, or panic).
preconditions: len(s) >= 1 and len(s) <= 1000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] is one of 65 ('A'), 76 ('L'), 80 ('P').

statement: Whenever check_record(s) returns a result r, if the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(s) and s[i] = 65 ('A') is at least 2, then r = false.
preconditions: len(s) >= 1 and len(s) <= 1000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] is one of 65 ('A'), 76 ('L'), 80 ('P').

statement: Whenever check_record(s) returns a result r, if there exists an index i with 0 <= i, i + 2 < len(s), and s[i] = s[i+1] = s[i+2] = 76 ('L'), then r = false.
preconditions: len(s) >= 1 and len(s) <= 1000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] is one of 65 ('A'), 76 ('L'), 80 ('P').

statement: Whenever check_record(s) returns a result r, if the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(s) and s[i] = 65 ('A') is at most 1 and there is no index i with 0 <= i, i + 2 < len(s), and s[i] = s[i+1] = s[i+2] = 76 ('L'), then r = true.
preconditions: len(s) >= 1 and len(s) <= 1000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] is one of 65 ('A'), 76 ('L'), 80 ('P').

statement: Let t be the byte sequence of length len(s) + 1 with t[i] = s[i] for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), and t[len(s)] = 80 ('P'). Both calls check_record(s) and check_record(t) return Boolean results r and r', and r = r'.
preconditions: len(s) >= 1, len(s) <= 999, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), s[i] is one of 65 ('A'), 76 ('L'), 80 ('P').

statement: Let t be the byte sequence of length len(s) + 1 with t[0] = 80 ('P'), and t[i+1] = s[i] for every i with 0 <= i < len(s). Both calls check_record(s) and check_record(t) return Boolean results r and r', and r = r'.
